comment: Playbook version -> exact git commit manifest. Historical site versions are materialized from these commits at build time (site/scripts/materialize-versions.mjs). The build verifies that playbook/VERSION at each commit matches the declared version and refuses to build otherwise. 'exclude' removes authoring scaffolding that was present inside playbook/ at release time but was never part of the released book (later archived to docs/history/playbook-v0.1/); every historical page still identifies the exact commit it was extracted from.
